messages:
matt: Quick discussion: how do we prioritize design partner asks vs roadmap commitments for the private deploy workstream? Need a lightweight rule set.
anya: Recurring ask from DP: better onboarding docs + shorter model-pinning flow. Roadmap has infra perf work scheduled same quarter. Maybe split into fast wins vs big bets.
kevin: Proposal: Triage into 3 lanes: 1) Surface fixes (docs/UX) within 2 weeks, 2) Measured infra changes (needs canary) in next sprint, 3) Research/architecture (quarterly). DP asks land in lane 1-2 mostly.
tia: Suggest adding "business impact" tag: revenue risk, security/regulatory, or exploratory. Use that to bump priority.
anya: Also add "effort" estimate (S/M/L) and "risk to run" (low/med/high). We can then score = impact * (1/effort) * urgency multiplier.
matto-bot: bot: Created label set: dp-fastwin, dp-infra, dp-research, impact-high, effort-small. Use /label apply <thread> <label>.
kevin: For DP commitments, add acceptance criteria: what counts as "done" for partner success so we don't ship partial. Eg: onboarding <7 min, pin flow completed, latency <Xms tail.
tia: For fastwins, CS can own delivery with Product review. For infra items, Eng & Product must co-sign before scheduling.
matt: OK next steps: 1) anya to draft scoring sheet and run sample on 6 outstanding DP asks, 2) kevin to map infra overlap and estimate effort, 3) tia to draft acceptance criteria templates. Reconvene Thu AM.
anya: Will share sheet by EOD.
kevin: I'll have estimates by Wed noon.
